description: HeliosphericTomographyIPS reconstructs solar-wind density and velocity by fitting a kinematic propagation model to interplanetary-scintillation measurements. The time-dependent volumes represent solar-wind structures and coronal-mass-ejection evolution. The resource is documented by UCSD. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented Japanese observations have seasonal winter gaps. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
